cohort: Full-term (>=37 weeks) nulliparous and multiparous patients with singleton gestations undergoing labor induction or presenting in labor, excluding those with planned cesarean delivery, fever on admission, or missing data.
finding: A validated prediction calculator for chorioamnionitis was created with an external validation area under the curve of 0.82, identifying several factors significantly associated with infection.
mod_finding: The developed calculator is specifically validated for predicting chorioamnionitis in patients undergoing labor induction at term.
